description: This Java class implements a command strategy for retrieving loan transaction details by ID within the Apache Fineract project. It processes batch requests, extracts parameters from the URL, and delegates the transaction retrieval to the injected LoanTransactionsApiResource.

classes.name: GetLoanTransactionByIdCommandStrategy
classes.description: Implements CommandStrategy to handle fetching a specific loan transaction by ID in batch processing scenarios, utilizing LoanTransactionsApiResource and parsing URL/query parameters.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command strategy to retrieve a loan transaction by ID. Parses URL for parameters, calls the API resource, and constructs BatchResponse with the result.
